topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I just can't seem to wrap my head around what happened this morning. I walked out to the driveway, expecting to hop into my car for my usual commute, and it was just... gone. The spot where it usually sits was empty, and there was a piece of paper on the ground with a number to call. It turns out, my car had been towed. I’ve been here for years, and this has never happened. I’m thinking maybe there was some kind of mistake or misunderstanding. I’m already making calls to sort this out, but it’s just not the start to the day I was expecting.
